=https://[proxmox domain or IP]/api2/json/nodes/[node name]/lxc/{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.vmid }}/status/start

parameters.command:
=set -e
WG_IP="{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.wgIp }}"
ENGINE="{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.engine }}"
DB_USER="{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.dbUser }}"
DB_PASS="{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.dbPass }}"
DB_NAME="{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.dbName }}"

# 1. Generate WireGuard keys and force restart tunnel
umask 077
systemctl stop wg-quick@wg0 2>/dev/null || true
wg genkey | tee /etc/wireguard/private.key | wg pubkey > /etc/wireguard/public.key
cat <<EOF > /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf
[Interface]
Address = ${WG_IP}/24
PrivateKey = $(cat /etc/wireguard/private.key)

[Peer]
PublicKey = 63+Phy6TqSfbBGtUeiMTJExqWIm+ZnbJYqgRq4Gr6nc=
Endpoint = 89.144.8.129:51820
AllowedIPs = 10.99.0.0/24
PersistentKeepalive = 25
EOF
systemctl enable wg-quick@wg0
systemctl restart wg-quick@wg0

# 2. Configure and FORCE RESTART the chosen database engine bound to WG_IP
if [ "$ENGINE" = "postgres" ]; then
  PG_CONF=$(find /etc/postgresql -name "postgresql.conf")
  PG_HBA=$(find /etc/postgresql -name "pg_hba.conf")
  sed -i "s/^#*listen_addresses.*/listen_addresses = '${WG_IP}'/" "$PG_CONF"
  grep -q "10.99.0.0/24" "$PG_HBA" || echo "host all all 10.99.0.0/24 scram-sha-256" >> "$PG_HBA"
  systemctl enable postgresql
  systemctl restart postgresql
  su - postgres -c "psql -tc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='${DB_USER}'\" | grep -q 1 || psql -c \"CREATE USER ${DB_USER} WITH PASSWORD '${DB_PASS}';\""
  su - postgres -c "psql -tc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${DB_NAME}'\" | grep -q 1 || psql -c \"CREATE DATABASE ${DB_NAME} OWNER ${DB_USER};\""
elif [ "$ENGINE" = "mysql" ]; then
  sed -i "s/^#*bind-address.*/bind-address = ${WG_IP}/" /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/50-server.cnf
  systemctl enable mariadb
  systemctl restart mariadb
  mysql -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ${DB_NAME};"
  mysql -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '${DB_USER}'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '${DB_PASS}';"
  mysql -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ${DB_NAME}.* TO '${DB_USER}'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
elif [ "$ENGINE" = "redis" ]; then
  sed -i "s/^bind .*/bind ${WG_IP}/" /etc/redis/redis.conf
  sed -i "s/^#* *requirepass .*/requirepass ${DB_PASS}/" /etc/redis/redis.conf
  systemctl enable redis-server
  systemctl restart redis-server
fi

cat /etc/wireguard/public.key

=/usr/local/sbin/register-client-lxc \
  "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.wgIp }}" \
  "{{ $json.stdout.trim() }}" \
  "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.publicPort }}" \
  "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.internalPort }}"
